scenario.title: 回顧這半年，展望下一步
scenario.context: 課程的最後一個單元：跟朋友回顧這半年的改變。你會用到所有的假設語氣：如果明天下雨（type 1）、如果我是你（type 2）、如果當初沒開始（type 3）、如果那時沒堅持，現在就不會（混合）、真希望早點開始（wish）。能流暢切換這些，你的英文就真的到 B2 了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Can you believe it's been six months since you started your English routine?
lines.zh: 你相信你開始每天練英文已經半年了嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Honestly, no. I remember being so nervous about ordering coffee in English.
lines.zh: 說真的不敢相信。我還記得當時用英文點咖啡都好緊張。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: And last week you led a whole client meeting in English. You've come a long way.
lines.zh: 而上週你用英文主持了一整場客戶會議。你進步好多。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: If I hadn't started back then, I wouldn't be working with international clients now.
lines.zh: 如果我當初沒開始，現在就不會跟國際客戶合作。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Only one. I wish I had started years ago.
lines.zh: 只有一個：真希望我好幾年前就開始。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Better late than never. Pat yourself on the back.
lines.zh: 遲到總比不到好。好好誇獎一下自己吧。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: If the London studio offers me the project, I'll take it.
lines.zh: 如果倫敦那間工作室給我那個案子，我就接。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Then I'll keep pitching. If I were more patient, I'd wait, but I'm not.
lines.zh: 那我就繼續提案。如果我更有耐心就會等，但我沒有。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Ha! Well, with your portfolio and your English, the sky's the limit.
lines.zh: 哈！嗯，憑你的作品集和英文，前途無可限量。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thanks, Jess. Here's to the next six months. Onwards and upwards!
lines.zh: 謝謝你，Jess。敬接下來的六個月，繼續向前！

patterns.en: If I hadn't ___, I wouldn't ___ now.
patterns.zh: 如果我當初沒 ___，現在就不會 ___。

patterns.en: I wish I had started earlier.
My goal for the next six months is ___.
patterns.zh: 我接下來半年的目標是 ___。

chinglish.wrong: If I didn't start, I won't work with foreign clients now.
chinglish.right: If I hadn't started, I wouldn't be working with international clients now.
chinglish.why: 過去沒做 → 現在的結果，用混合條件句（第 88 單元）。另外 foreign clients 改成 international clients 更得體。

chinglish.right: I wish I had started earlier.
chinglish.why: 對過去的遺憾用 wish + had + p.p.（第 68 單元）。

chinglish.wrong: My English is progress a lot.
chinglish.right: My English has improved a lot. / I've made a lot of progress.
chinglish.why: progress 是名詞（或動詞但少這樣用），進步用 improve 或 make progress。

chinglish.wrong: If they will offer me the job, I will take it.
chinglish.right: If they offer me the job, I'll take it.
chinglish.why: if 子句不用 will（第 39 單元）。這是課程第一個假設語氣，也是最常見的錯誤。

grammar.title: 假設語氣全系列
grammar.oneLiner: 判斷兩件事：假設的是現在、過去、還是未來？可能還是不可能？時態往過去退一格 = 離現實更遠。
whenToUse: Type 1（真的可能）：If + 現在式, will + V。If it rains, I'll stay home.
Type 2（現在不可能）：If + 過去式, would + V。If I were rich, I'd travel.
Type 3（過去不可能）：If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.。If I had known, I would have come.
混合（過去 → 現在）：If + had + p.p., would + V。If I had studied, I'd be a doctor now.
wish（現在）：wish + 過去式。/ wish（過去）：wish + had + p.p.。/ wish + would：希望別人改變。
It's essential that + 原形（第 84 單元）；If I were you…（第 45 單元）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 這是整個課程的最後一個文法點，也是最能看出中文和英文思維差異的地方：中文的「如果」「要是」「真希望」幾乎不需要改變動詞，全靠時間詞和語氣；英文則用一套精密的時態系統，把「可能性」和「時間」都編碼在動詞裡。從第 39 單元到這裡，你已經學完整套系統了。接下來需要的不是更多規則，而是大量開口，讓它變成直覺。

examples.correct: If I get the project, I'll move to London for three months.
If I were you, I'd take the offer.
If I had known about this course earlier, I would have started sooner.
If I hadn't practiced every day, I wouldn't be this confident now.
examples.incorrect: If I didn't practice every day, I won't be this confident now.

examples.correct: I wish I could speak as naturally as a native speaker.

quiz.question: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
If I ___ you, I'd apply for that job.
If I had saved more, I ___ a house by now.
quiz.explanation: 混合：過去原因 + 現在結果（by now）。

quiz.question: If she had asked me, I ___ have helped her. (過去)
I wish I ___ English when I was a kid.

slang.meaning: 進步很多、走了很長的路
slang.usage: You've come a long way! = 你進步好多！也用在科技、社會的發展。

examples.en: Your English has come a long way this year.
examples.zh: 你的英文今年進步好多。

examples.en: Phones have come a long way since the 90s.
examples.zh: 手機從 90 年代到現在進步好多。

slang.meaning: 前途無可限量、沒有極限
slang.usage: 可能性無窮，只要努力什麼都做得到。

examples.en: With your talent, the sky's the limit.
examples.zh: 以你的才華，前途無可限量。

examples.en: For this project, the sky's the limit. Be creative!
examples.zh: 這個案子沒有限制，盡情發揮！

slang.usage: 度過困難或完成階段後，表示要繼續向前。英式較常用。

examples.en: The project's done. Onwards and upwards!
It was a tough year, but onwards and upwards.
examples.zh: 今年很辛苦，但會越來越好。

slang.usage: 肯定自己的努力和成就。

examples.en: You finished all 90 units. Pat yourself on the back!
examples.zh: 你完成了全部 90 個單元，好好誇獎自己吧！

examples.en: Take a moment to pat yourself on the back.
examples.zh: 花點時間肯定一下自己。

review.question: I'm so proud ___ how far I've come.
If I hadn't taken that class, I ___ you now.
review.explanation: 複習第 88 單元：混合條件句。

review.question: I'm looking forward to ___ the next chapter.
review.explanation: 複習第 86 單元：look forward to + V-ing。

review.question: Learners ___ (practice) every day improve the fastest.
review.explanation: 複習第 82 單元：減化關係子句。

review.question: I'm ___ thrilled with my progress.
review.explanation: 複習第 74 單元：極端形容詞用 absolutely。

review.question: I ___ be scared of speaking English, but now I enjoy it.
If I ___ more time, I'd learn another language.
If I ___ this every day, I'll get even better.
I ___ English for six months now.
review.explanation: 複習第 26 單元：完成進行式。

review.question: Back to the beginning! Which is the best way to order?
options: Can I get a latte, please?
review.explanation: 複習第 2 單元：你第一週學的句子。

review.question: A: What's up? B: ___
options: I'm fine, thank you, and you?
review.explanation: 複習第 1 單元：一切的開始。

review.question: You finished all 90 units. You've come a long ___!
review.explanation: come a long way = 進步很多。
